findings.text: ACTED_WORD and DECLINED_WORD are a second declaration of the response vocabulary that reckon/crew/plan_review.py:116 RESPONSE_ACTIONS already owns, and the reuse map this node's done_when cites states the vocabulary must not be re-invented: a rename on the plan-review side leaves this brief emitting a spelling nothing else recognises, and no test crosses the two.

the expected ids are computed by the code under test (repair.review_findings) rather than from an independent source, so the assertion holds for any minting scheme — a mutation making finding_id return a constant keeps len(ids) == 3 true and still finds that id in a brief whose three lines then carry one colliding id, which is the collision that makes a finding impossible to answer back.

the idempotence assertion composes the same stored record twice, so a node_id that ignored the reviewed head would pass while the round identity's discriminating half — a later review of the same run at a new head being a different round — is never exercised.
